sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
The EXTRAs module is a collection of integration tools — connecting the hotel to external systems:

- Channel Manager: OTA bookings (MakeMyTrip, Booking.com etc.) and rate/inventory sync
- WhatsApp: automatic guest messages (booking confirmation, check-in/out, offers)
- Smart Card: card-based payments (with the Members module)
- E-Invoice: GST e-invoice generation (IRN) for B2B bills

This module is mostly used by admin/IT — set up once, then it runs automatically.

subsections.title: 5.1 EInvoice Parameter
subsections.paragraph: GST portal/API credentials — company GSTIN, e-invoice API keys, applicable document types (B2B invoices only), auto-generate threshold (mandatory for those with Rs 5 crore turnover).

subsections.title: 5.2 EInvoice Flow & Report
subsections.paragraph: When a B2B bill is settled, an e-invoice is generated — you get an IRN (Invoice Reference Number) + QR code which prints on the bill. The EInvoice Report keeps a record of all generated e-invoices + a cancellation option.
